psychological_meaning: Cafe Royale evokes feelings of warmth, comfort, and sophistication. It is associated with earthiness, stability, and a sense of understated elegance. This color can also suggest reliability and dependability, making it a grounding choice.

real_world_examples.title: Leather Armchair
real_world_examples.description: A classic leather armchair in Cafe Royale adds a touch of timeless elegance to any living space.

real_world_examples.title: Coffee Beans Packaging
real_world_examples.description: Premium coffee beans are often packaged using Cafe Royale to convey a sense of richness and quality.

how_to_pair: Pair with cream for a classic look.
Combine with teal for a sophisticated contrast.
Use with gold accents for a luxurious feel.
